MessageSetTheMaximumBitrateInMbps: Set the maximum bitrate in Mbps. Set to 0 to use Roku's specifications. This setting must be enabled to take effect.

MessageYouCanSearchForTitlesPeople: You can search for Titles, People, Live TV Channels and more

SettingDescDisplayLanguage: Choose the language for all app text. 'Automatic' uses your Jellyfin server or Roku device language. Changes take effect after leaving Settings.
SettingDescHomeRowSize: Sets how many items the Recently Added, On Now and Active Recordings rows load; Continue Watching and Next Up always show your full list. Higher values load more slowly, especially on older devices or with many libraries. Applies next time Home loads.
SettingDescSigninScreenLanguage: Language for the sign-in screens, shown before anyone logs in. 'Automatic' uses the Roku device language. Takes effect next time you sign in.
SettingResetAllSettingsToTheirDefault: Reset all settings to their default values. Your login session will not be affected.
